test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Combine : Separate : : Insufficient : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Combine : Separate → Combine is antonym of Separate.

Similarly,

 
• Insufficient : ? → Insufficient is antonym of Abundant.

Hence, '**Abundant**' is the correct answer.
